headline: BAL @ LAD matchup research
quickWriteup: The current model score is BAL 3.95 at LAD 4.62, with a projected total of 8.57. The projected total fell -0.94, which points to a lower-run game script than the earliest saved read. Pitching context: Roki Sasaki has the better recent run-prevention profile in the available outing logs at 2.2 ER over the last 5 outings. Batter research is strongest for Freddie Freeman, Shohei Ohtani, Ryan Ward, based on recent hit rates, matching location/opponent samples, or similar-game production. The cold/risk list flags Alex Freeland because the recent hit profile or strikeout trend is weaker than the projection alone would show.
